method: Cook the chicken with the BBQ until done and nicely coloured.
Warm the flatbreads and spread with yoghurt or mayo.
Fill with the chicken, red peppers and kale and salad, roll up tightly and serve.

name: Salsa Roja Pork Slow-Cooked
blurb: Salsa Roja pork with butternut squash and leeks, served with potatoes.
method: Brown the pork, then add the Salsa Roja, butternut squash and leeks and enough liquid to almost cover.
Cover and cook low for 3-4 hours (or a slow cooker on low for 7-8) until meltingly tender.
Shred or leave in chunks and serve over potatoes.

Spoon over the bowls with any extra dressing and a scatter of seeds or herbs.

name: Miso Aubergine Noodles

method: Cook the noodles to packet instructions, then drain and toss with a little oil.

Serve straight away with extra chilli, lime or sesame.
